question.prompt: A line has an angle of inclination of \(90^\circ\). What is its angle with the \(y\)-axis, in degrees?

solutions.explanation: A line with an angle of inclination of \(90^\circ\) is perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis and has the same direction as the \(y\)-axis, so the angle is \(0^\circ\).
solutions.title: Recognize a vertical line
